title: Search
scope: Find records or open tools in {workspace}.
loadFailed: Records could not be loaded. Navigation and event tools still work.
noRecords: No accessible records found. Try another phrase.
noMatch: No matching commands. Enter at least two letters or numbers to find records.
showingEight: Showing eight records. Refine your phrase or open Search for all results.
openShortcut: <kbd>Cmd/Ctrl + K</kbd> opens Search outside editors and dialogs. Use Up/Down to choose a result, Enter to open it, and Escape to close.
componentNote: Opens the picker from the selected event page, outside editors and dialogs. Requires edit access and room on the page.
submitNote: <kbd>Cmd/Ctrl + Enter</kbd> saves from an event, schedule, task, expense, or reminder field. Save validation still applies.
buttonsNote: Buttons remain available without shortcuts. These choices are saved on this browser when storage is available. Native text undo is unchanged.
undoShortcut: <kbd>Cmd/Ctrl + Z</kbd> undoes your last edit outside text fields, and the last layout change while arranging; <kbd>Shift + Cmd/Ctrl + Z</kbd> redoes it.
